items.title: Michael Pittman: Officially placed on IR
items.text:

items.title: Michael Pittman: Bound for injured reserve

items.title: DJ Moore: Questionable for Week 5
items.text:

items.title: Terry McLaurin: Trending toward playing Sunday
items.text:
McLaurin (hamstring) remains a game-time decision for Sunday's game against the Giants, with a "slight lean" toward him playing, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Myles Garrett: Not ready to practice
items.text:
Garrett (knee), per head coach Sean McVay, is "on track" in his recovery but is not expected to return to practice next week, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
